'''Margani Altis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Djinn Altis/Legends|Djinn Altis]]. Although the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Old Order]] were forbidden to form bonds, Master Altis secretly took Margani as his wife. She [[Death/Legends|passed away]] a few years before the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Even during the war between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]], Master Djinn regretted her death and said he would have been a better Jedi with her.
